Thanks for the report. I checked the docs and earlier issues. I found no exact duplicate. Related but not the same: #8365 (v8 ignore hints ignored in 4.0 beta) and #8497 (istanbul ignore else with experimentalAstAwareRemapping).

The docs (`docs/guide/coverage.md`, "try catch" example) list `catch (error) /* v8 ignore next */ { ... }` as supported with rolldown-vite. So this should work in principle.

Things to check:
- Your snippet has a syntax error: the `try` block is missing its closing `}`, and `consolr` looks like a typo for `console`. Please confirm these aren't in your real code.
- Whether the comment survives the transform. Other examples in the docs use `-- @preserve`. Try `/* v8 ignore next -- @preserve */`.

If it still fails, please share a minimal reproduction (StackBlitz or a repo) with your vitest config, including `coverage.experimentalAstAwareRemapping` if set. Please also include the rolldown-vite version.
